prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized artifact / relic marker. A diamond-shaped talisman — an
outer diamond outline with a smaller concentric inner diamond inside
it. Simplified app-icon geometry: both diamonds are flat saturated
palette colors (outer one color, inner a contrasting palette color),
sharp clean edges. Centered in the icon area. No sparkle, no glow, no
texture — flat geometric shapes only.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat vector app icon; modern UI icon register in the vein of SF Symbols Filled; centered single-subject composition on plain off-white canvas with generous padding; crisp sharp edges throughout; zero brushwork, zero texture, zero gradients

SUBJECT: a concentric double-diamond talisman shape — a large outer diamond and a smaller inner diamond centered within it; both diamonds are solid flat fills with sharp clean geometric edges; the outer diamond is vivid red (#FF0000) and the inner diamond is vivid blue (#0000FF); the gap between the two diamonds reads as white (#FFFFFF) negative space; both shapes are simplified to pure rotated-square geometry

CONTEXT: map marker icon for an artifact or relic location; isolated centered icon asset, no surrounding scene

COLOR: outer diamond filled vivid red (#FF0000); inner diamond filled vivid blue (#0000FF); separating band pure white (#FFFFFF); icon canvas off-white

DETAILS: every edge is a straight vector line, no rounding; inner diamond scaled to roughly forty percent of the outer diamond's span; the two diamonds share the same center point and the same axis; bold enough to read as a distinct silhouette at 16px; no drop shadow, no outline stroke beyond the shape fills themselves

CONSTRAINTS: flat UI icon only; no parchment, no ink, no painterly marks, no gradients, no glow, no sparkle, no texture, no weathering; clean 2026-era app iconography
